question: A man goes towards east 5 km, then he takes 120 degrees right turn and goes 5 km. He again takes 120 degrees right turn and goes 5 km. With respect to the starting point, where is he now?
solution: According to the given information, 1) A man goes towards east 5 km. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40db79b6481172e793cde3b21009f5410cc331eb14a5b891312a481ebd0f4970.png] 2) Then he takes 120 degrees right turn and goes 5 km.
